programmes.d: Alain has been brought to court for not finishing a custom outfit he says is because he was hospitalized.
Sabrina is suing her child's father after claiming he threw a man-tantrum and broke their son's tablet.
Prestonie sues his mother for assault and hotel bills and claims she admitted to hating him.
Destiny is suing her Father for property damage after she claims he damaged the hood of her car.
Jeretha is petitioning the court for a DNA test to be given to a woman she thinks is her sister.
Juana is suing Jorge after the bird he sold her died after 3 hours, she wants her money back for the bird and autopsy.
Alfonso believes William deliberately set fire to his van to cover up the damages he caused.
When Paul's expensive remote control helicopter "disappears" from Sean's consignment shop, Paul claims foul play.
Forrest hired the defendant to make a music video but claims he took too much creative liberty and wouldn't listen.
Miguel is suing his friend of 30 years because he believes the defendant is the cause of his dog's death.
Robert is suing his young fling Latasha after claiming she damaged his property.
Christopher is being sued by his mother for parking tickets after being unable to forgive her for choosing drugs.
Trying to regain custody of her children, Shamika wants to prove that her ex is the father of her youngest child.
Derek is suing for breach of contract after claiming the female dancers he ordered were on their phones.
Joan is taking Sena to court after she gave away 5 cats she asked Sena to care for after Hurricane Sandy.
Eleanor believes that the defendant may be the daughter of her brother, who has been deceased for 18 years.
Jill is suing Laura after failing to repay a loan, but Laura says it was a gift.
Brian is suing Robert after he installed a faulty DVD player in Brian's car that hasn't worked right since day 1.
Andrea wants $3000 from her ex-boyfriend after stealing from her during her active addiction.
